messages:
alex.support: FYI — Shoply (tenant cid-987) is seeing 429s on /v1/rerank starting ~08:15 UTC. Customer says only rerank is affected; embeddings/generation OK. Error JSON: {"error":"Rate limit exceeded","type":"rerank_quota"} 

sam.engineer: Repro snippet they sent:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-..." \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"query":"best shoes","candidates":["id1","id2",...,"id10000"]}'
```
They included a single request with ~10k candidates in payload.

ratebot: ALERT: rate-limiter fired: policy=rerank_per_tenant tenant=cid-987 window=60s allowed=5000 scored_candidates current=10234 429_count=46 @ 2024-03-31T08:14:20Z

maria.sre: Looks like candidate_count spike. Our current per-tenant quota is 5k candidate-scores/min (counts each candidate scored). 10k candidates in one request will exhaust the bucket quickly. Confirming metrics: rerank_scored_candidates shows a 10k spike at 08:14.

chris.cs: I reached out to the Shoply contact — they said a background job started bulk-sending candidate dumps after a config change earlier. They've paused the job on their side. They asked if we can temporarily lift limits while they rerun in smaller batches. :+1:

sam.engineer: From our side, the 429 responses include Retry-After: 60 and body with type rerank_quota. Example 429 body: {"error":"Rate limit exceeded","retry_after":60,"quota":"rerank_per_tenant"}. Logs show throttling key tenant:cid-987:rerank bucket exhausted.

maria.sre: Proposed mitigations:
- Short term: bump Shoply quota to 10k candidates/min for 2 hours while they backfill (ops change).
- Customer guidance: limit candidates per request to <=200 and add exponential backoff on 429s.
- Medium term: add per-request candidate_count hard limit (reject >2000) and better 429 payload explaining candidate_count and remaining_quota.

alex.support: Action items:
- alex.support -> open INC-2026-089 (include logs + ratebot alert)
- maria.sre -> approve temporary quota bump and perform change (ops ticket)
- chris.cs -> confirm customer paused job and will follow best-practice batch sizes
- sam.engineer -> add short doc snippet for support replies with sample backoff logic and example curl showing smaller candidate array

chris.cs: Customer confirmed pause and thanks for the quick response. They will re-run in batches of 100 and report back.

alex.support: I'll follow up after quota bump and close incident once no 429s for 30m. Marking this thread for postmortem to consider soft-fail fallback for rerank (e.g., partial scoring + warning). :memo:
